Morpho is a decentralized lending protocol deployed on Ethereum and other public blockchains. Morpho matches lenders and borrowers peer-to-peer on top of existing liquidity pools. Morpho Blue is a permissionless, immutable lending primitive with isolated markets. Morpho Vaults are managed by independent vault curators.

LayerZero is an omnichain interoperability protocol for cross-chain messaging. LayerZero uses separate oracle and relayer entities as independent verifiers of cross-chain messages. LayerZero is deployed through endpoint smart contracts on multiple blockchains.

Portal is a cross-chain token bridge associated with the Wormhole protocol. Portal enables transfers of tokens between different blockchains. Portal is connected to the PORTAL governance token.

Terra (LUNA) is a proof-of-stake layer-1 blockchain. Terra (LUNA) uses the LUNA token as its native staking and governance token. Terra (LUNA) hosted the algorithmic stablecoin UST. Terra (LUNA) and UST collapsed in May 2022.

USDS is a decentralized, overcollateralized stablecoin in the Sky ecosystem. USDS was introduced by Sky as an upgrade of the DAI stablecoin. USDS can be swapped one-to-one with DAI.
